title: Harold T NDE 4904
content: It was a normal day. I had come into work early feeling good. I developed a headache and went to medical for an aspirin. As soon as I entered medical, my chest had exploded with pain. The nurse put me in a chair and started putting aspirin down my throat, and then called for an ambulance. I remember being put in the ambulance and then a second ambulance came in and everyone was running around. Then I was watching them from above. I was staring right in their faces and laughing. I could see them sweating and sticking me with a needle and yelling. I really couldn't hear because of the static-like sound. I could see myself. It looked like my face had sagged and changed color. I began to yell at myself but nothing happened. Then I was free like a bird. I could see the guys I work with talking to the boss. Then I was where it was as bright as could be, not like the sun, but a white bright. It was cold, but not cold. It was peaceful. I could hear this static get louder and could see grayish smoke like figures that seemed to pass through me. Then I could feel memories of people that I had known and memories. The static became louder and it felt like men who were waiting for something had touched me. Then I was being heated up with blankets and doctors checking me. I don't know what happened, all I know is that whatever it was - it was incredible.

arrival.other_being_detail: “grayish smoke like figures” that “seemed to pass through me”

environment.environment_other_detail: “white bright”; “It was cold, but not cold. It was peaceful.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden chest pain/possible cardiac event at work; transported by ambulance.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Static-like sound; “grayish smoke like figures” passing through; sensed “memories of people that I had known.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE during ambulance/resuscitation scene, then bright white peaceful realm with smoke-like figures and loud static, then return to body with doctors/blankets.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prominent “static-like sound” throughout; “grayish smoke like figures” passing through the experiencer; “felt like men who were waiting for something had touched me.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I was watching them from above.” / “Then I was free like a bird.” / “Then I was where it was as bright as could be, not like the sun, but a white bright.” / “I could hear this static get louder and could see grayish smoke like figures that seemed to pass through me.”
